firm_data.firm_description: Federman Steifman LLP is a boutique law firm specializing in complex and sophisticated real estate, structured finance and corporate transactions. The firm structures and closes large commercial mortgage loans, the acquisition of mortgage loans and loan portfolios and workouts and restructuring of real estate financings and credit facilities.
notable_facts: Recognized in the 2026 Chambers USA Regional Spotlight Guide for Real Estate & Real Estate Finance
Four partners named by The Legal 500 among the U.S. City Elite lawyers in New York for real estate and real estate finance in March 2026

email.subject: AI for Federman Steifman, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Michael,

Your firm's recognition in the 2026 Chambers USA Regional Spotlight Guide for Real Estate and Real Estate Finance reflects the caliber of work you're handling on complex commercial mortgage loans and structured finance transactions. That sophistication demands precision tools.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in New York to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
